text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for Rice Shower for<n>some time
now. As the sun begins to<n>set...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-sorry! I was looking for something<n>at the park.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... I didn't lose anything, but<n>another girl at the
park did.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
She lost her hat and asked me to help<n>her look for
it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I told her it was bad luck for me to<n>help, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: She kept crying, and there was no<n>one else around.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... We found it pretty quickly, but<n>then it got
blown away by the wind,<n>and it took some time to
get it back.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But... she was so happy once I gave<n>her the hat
back... It made me really<n>happy too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Still, I know that's no excuse for<n>missing training...
I'm sorry.

I tell her she did the right thing, but<n>also that she
should contact me next<n>time something like that
happens.
